title: Raj Ojha - Core Lead & AI Systems Architect
summary: Raj Ojha is a core lead, AI researcher, and systems architect at NextGen SuperComputing Club, KIET.
content: Raj Ojha is a core lead, AI researcher, and systems architect at the NextGen SuperComputing Club at KIET Group of Institutions. He is one of the key minds behind the club's computing initiatives and the Riva multimodal voice assistant platform. His expertise includes High-Performance Computing (HPC), distributed multi-agent systems, low-latency voice-to-voice streaming, and GPU-accelerated computing. Raj is actively involved in researching autonomous AI workflows, digital human avatars with real-time lip-sync, and supercomputing architectures.

title: NextGen SuperComputing Club
summary: NextGen SuperComputing Club is the advanced HPC & AI research club at KIET.
content: NextGen SuperComputing Club is an advanced research and engineering student community at KIET Group of Institutions, Ghaziabad. The club focuses on high-performance computing, distributed supercomputing clusters, deep learning, agentic AI systems, and next-generation Nvidia architectures. They are the creators of the Riva Voice and Riva AGI platforms.

title: Riva Multimodal Real-Time Assistant
summary: Riva is an intelligent real-time conversational voice assistant with a 3D digital human avatar.
content: Riva is a real-time multimodal conversational voice assistant featuring bidirectional WebRTC/WebSocket audio streaming, low-latency Gemini Live integration, a 3D digital human avatar with real-time phoneme lip-syncing, and an autonomous multi-agent orchestration backend.

title: Chirag Tejasvi - AI Engineer & NextGen Supercomputing Member
summary: Chirag Tejasvi is a 2nd year B.Tech CSE (AI/ML) student at KIET, ML Coordinator at InnoGeeks, and technical/PR contributor at NextGen Supercomputing working on Multi-Agent Orchestration and Riva.
content:
TYPE: PERSON

Name: Chirag Tejasvi
Academic Year: Second Year
Program/Branch: B.Tech CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning)
Section: B
Club/Organization: InnoGeeks; NextGen Supercomputing

[ABOUT]
A Computer Science undergraduate specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Passionate about technology, AI/ML, problem-solving, and building practical AI systems.

[INTERESTS]
Generative AI, LLMs, Multi-Agent Systems, AI engineering, web development, coding, problem-solving, photography, travelling, badminton, and exploring new technologies.

[SKILLS]
Python, Java, C, C++, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Multi-Agent Systems, FastAPI, web development, SQL, and AI system design.

[EXPERIENCE]
ML Coordinator at InnoGeeks. Technical and PR role at NextGen Supercomputing. Participated in a social internship focused on teaching AI concepts to Classes I-V using simple real-life examples and activity-based learning. This developed communication, leadership, classroom management, public speaking, creativity, logical thinking, and social responsibility.

[PROJECTS]
- MuktiVerse: An AI orchestration framework focused on coordinating LLM workers, agents, tools, memory, RAG, knowledge graphs, model routing, and multimodal workflows.
- Riva-AGI: An Artificial Cognitive Intelligence project aiming to evolve AI beyond a simple chatbot toward a Jarvis-like cognitive system.
- MuktiVersAIO: An autonomous intelligence orchestration system involving planners, agents, tools, model routing, RAG, memory, and workflow orchestration.
- jALERT: A FastAPI-based AI system involving agents, mapping, chatbot/voice interaction, and administration.
- SkillBridgeAI: An AI-focused project for skills and learning.
- HouseFind: A machine-learning-based property prediction/recommendation project.
- Agraan AI: Work related to AI-based weather nowcasting and a geospatial command-center concept.

[CURRENTLY]
Working on AI systems involving Multi-Agent Orchestration, LLM workflows, RAG, tool calling, model routing, and autonomous AI architectures. Contributing to Riva as part of the college club.

[LEARNING]
FastAPI, DSA, Java, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Multi-Agent Systems, React, DBMS, Cloud Foundations, and AI system design.

[GOALS]
Become a strong AI engineer and build advanced AI systems involving Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and Multi-Agent Systems. Long-term goal is to build impactful AI technology and eventually create an AI company.

[COLLABORATION]
Interested in collaborating on AI/ML projects, Generative AI, LLM applications, RAG systems, Multi-Agent Systems, AI orchestration, and practical AI engineering.
